ud3.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya kāyagatāya satiyā ajjhattaṃ supatiṭṭhitāya.
ud3.5:1.4: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ . . . pe . . . supatiṭṭhitāya.
ud3.5:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
